Nora (CS): Quick sync for Auriga dedicated pool bring-up. Need final quota, autoscale knobs, and a 30m load window tomorrow.
Devon Ops: Traffic shape? steady embeddings + chat spikes?
Nora (CS): Correct. Baseline ~22k tok/s, spikes to ~88k tok/s. Renewal risk noted if p95 > 350ms first 72h.
Maya (SE): Proposal: reserved=5 GPUs, autoscale min=2 max=18, warm_burst=4. Pre-warm KV for top-40 queries 20m prior.
Kai (SRE): Autoscale draft: scale_up if GPU_util > 70% for 45s, scale_down if < 30% for 150s, step +2, cooldown 90s.
prime-bot: Created channel #inc-1812340000-auriga-priming :construction:
Maya (SE): Load script for ops:
```
./load_runner --model redwood-4x --target 88000 --ramp 600 --dur 900 --kv-prime top40.json
```
Devon Ops: We'll set temp throttle at 125% committed and billing alert if cost delta >20%/hr.
Nora (CS): Enablement checklist: KMS ok, API key rotation done, SSO mapping verified, network egress rules good.
Kai (SRE): Telemetry: capture kv_hit_rate, batch_size hist, token_cost per req. Add alert for error_rate > 2% sustained 2m.
Maya (SE): I'll run a dry smoke today 16:30 UTC and post traces.
Nora (CS): Owners: post-test report -> Maya, ops runbook -> Devon, enablement notes -> Nora. I'll notify customer after dry smoke :thumbsup:
